senses.gloss: m. (חָדַק, הָ׳) that which is sqeezed in to fill a gap, repair, insertion.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 57b:14">Ḥull. 57ᵇ</cite> one who had a hole in the (fractured) scull, <he>ועשו לו ח׳ של קרויה וכ׳</he> ed. (Ar. <he>ה׳ של קרא …</he>) and they inserted a piece of a pumpkin shell, and he recovered.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 3:5">Kel. III, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ ק׳ הכרויה</he> R. S. (ed. only <he>ח׳ ק׳</he>) the lining of a pumpkin shell that has been hollowed out (to be used as a drawing vessel, i.e. the earthen vessel or clay which has been fitted in as a protection); <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 3:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. III, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ הק׳ הברויה</he> (v. <cite ref="B01191"><he>בָּרָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="K01095"><he>כָּרָה</he></cite>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:2:4">Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ</cite> top <he>ה׳ קירויה וכרויה</he> (read <he>הכרויה</he>).
